raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the “larger Hall of Fame” recognizing the sanctioning body. After WebSurfer correctly found that Vince Phillips held the IBF junior welterweight title, the Planner incorrectly claimed the recognizing body was the World Boxing Hall of Fame (WBHF) and finalized without verification. The widely recognized larger hall is the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF), not WBHF.
